aboutSection.title: LSPP 306 - Tiga Puluh Juni
aboutSection.desc1: LSPP 306 (Tiga Puluh Juni) is a professional certification body committed to improving competency standards and worker professionalism in its field. We serve as a strategic partner for individuals and organizations seeking to ensure qualifications and expertise aligned with applicable national standards.
aboutSection.desc2: With over a decade of experience, LSPP 306 has served thousands of certification participants from various industry sectors. We operate under official license and are recognized by the National Professional Certification Board (BNSP), ensuring that every certificate we issue has high recognition value in both national and international job markets.
aboutSection.desc3: We believe that certified competence is the foundation of solid careers and highly competitive organizations. LSPP 306 remains committed to providing professional, objective, and trustworthy competency testing services to all stakeholders.

flow.title: Certification Flow
flow.subtitle: Understand the steps in the application process until the issuance of your competency certification.

steps.title: Submit Certification Application
steps.description: Prospective test taker submits application to take certification and selects scheme, completing required documents

steps.title: Document Verification and Validation
steps.description: LSP admin verifies and validates required documents. If deemed acceptable, test taker will be scheduled for competency testing.

steps.title: Assessment Fee Payment
steps.description: Prospective test taker makes payment. Proof of payment is submitted to Admin.

steps.title: Certification Decision Determination
steps.description: Assessor submits assessment results to LSP. LSP reviews and objectively determines if test taker is competent or not in documented manner.

steps.title: Competency Certification Issuance
steps.description: For test takers deemed competent, LSP issues official competency certificate recognized by BNSP
